name: What is the difference between property restoration and remodeling?
description: Restoration repairs damage to pre-loss condition, while remodeling updates or changes a property for aesthetic or functional improvements.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between property restoration and remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property restoration focuses on returning a damaged property to its pre-loss condition, emphasizing repair and structural integrity. Remodeling, conversely, involves updating or changing the existing structure for aesthetic or functional improvements, often exceeding the original state. A key practical tradeoff is that restoration aims to match existing materials and layouts, while remodeling offers the freedom to choose new designs and materials. Hometelligent Inc. handles both, but the scope and objectives differ significantly.
